tutorial.title: Epicycloid Generator
tutorial.subtitle: Quick start guide
tutorial.step1Body:
Epicycloidal curve — orbit 2 revolves around the end of orbit 1 and its path is traced.
Line intersection — both orbits start from the center and the line between the two planets is drawn.
tutorial.step2Body: Change the radius and speed (RPM) of each orbit. The ratio between the two speeds determines the shape of the pattern. Use the Initial phase to offset the starting point.
tutorial.step3Body: The animation draws in real time. You can change the color, opacity and stroke weight parameters while it is running.
tutorial.step4Body: Use the mouse wheel over the canvas to zoom the view in or out. You can also use the ＋ / − buttons in the bottom-right corner of the canvas. Zoom does not affect the accumulated drawing, only the view.
tutorial.step5Body: Expand the Advanced parameters section to enable elliptic factors (squash or stretch the orbit) and tilt the orbital plane.
tutorial.step6Body: Undo last session removes the last drawn block (each click removes one more), without losing the parameters. Reset returns everything to the initial state.
tutorial.stepRandomizeBody: Out of ideas? Click 🎲 Randomize parameters to assign random values within the valid ranges and discover new patterns. The visualization mode is kept. Only available while the animation is paused.
tutorial.step7Body:
Export pattern (JSON) saves a file with all the parameters and the running time of each simulation block. You can pause, change parameters and hit Play again several times: each block is recorded as an independent instance in the JSON.
Import pattern (JSON) loads that file and rebuilds the drawing instantly, exactly as it was generated.
tutorial.stepExportImageTitle: Export your artwork as an image
tutorial.stepExportImageBody: Use Export image to save the composition as a PNG. You can choose the background (color or transparent), the zoom, the resolution (1×, 2× or 4×) and whether to show the reference circles and the center dot. You'll see a preview before saving.
tutorial.stepLanguageBody: Use the 🌐 selector in the top-left corner to change the interface language at any time. The app detects your browser language on entry and remembers your choice.
